question: What does the first manual visual pass over IA-located CISI pages establish?
immediate_consequence: H-789, H-930, and optional H-910 have two labeled source panels matching local side count; H-771, H-893, H-925, H-983, and H-353 require side-count or variant reconciliation; H-212 is a register locator only.
source_boundary: This visual pass confirms page/panel availability and reconciliation risks only. It does not accept 032/033/034 subtype readings, direction, side function, meaning, number, language, or translation.
